verdict.rationale: Registering SSH keys for Git authentication is a fair axis for a self-hosted Git service, but nothing in the evidence pack documents SSH key registration or SSH-based Git authentication. The security claims (permissions, ACLs, audit logs, SAML, OAuth2/OIDC) are adjacent controls, and the community mention of an SSH port-forward is a user-side workaround for reaching the web UI, so neither earns credit.
